vb_textbox.text: There is normally one gnome of the pair who will give you more mushrooms. Try both gnomes a couple of times to see which one is better. Once you know which one it is, stick with that one until the amount it gives you decreases to about 4. When it starts giving you less, try both gnomes again to work out which one is giving the most now. The gnomes that give you more will change several times during the game, so keep watch and don't be afraid to reevaluate if you feel your chosen gnome is no longer giving you enough!
